info.name: Listing Moderation
info.description:
Import this collection into Postman and start the service with `make run`. Run the entire collection in folder order, 00 through 15, using Collection Runner.

The startup request creates a fresh collection variable, `runId`. Listing titles and idempotency keys include this suffix to isolate runs against the persistent development database. Restart from folder 00 for a new run.

Polling requests repeat while a listing is pending; approval paths continue through auto_approved until published. The default pollTimeoutMs is 60000. Manual Send executes a request once; send it again while the listing is pending or auto_approved.

Folders 12 and 14 send concurrent HTTP requests from scripts. These checks observe HTTP results; lease recovery, worker crash/restart, database atomicity and cold-start timing are covered separately by repository tests. This collection does not replace make test.

Expiry uses the configured LISTING_TTL_DAYS, which defaults to 30 days. A normal collection run does not wait for expiry.

Inspect large int64 prices in the raw response. Numeric displays based on JavaScript Number may round values above 2^53-1. Boundary request bodies use raw Text to preserve their exact numeric tokens; do not reformat them.

baseUrl defaults to http://localhost:8080. Change it when using a different host port, such as PORT=8081 make run.

exec: throw new Error("Run folder 00 first to initialize runId and verify /livez.");
